theorem_statement: At A=1 the parent-ledger crossing is closed, so the completed WRITE is a boundary-address object. The manifold address axis has M_w=4 from two oriented faces times two surface dimensions. The route-depth axis has D_route=3 from C_w weights 1/2+1/2+1+1. Because these are distinct address axes, R=M_w*D_route=4*3=12. A0 is applied only after R is fixed.
